_comment: Pages withheld from a published document.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AND IS RENDERED. An undisclosed removal from a
published court record is falsification; a disclosed one is redaction.
Courts publish redacted versions routinely, and the thing that makes it
redaction rather than misrepresentation is that a reader can see a page
So this is not an internal note. Every entry renders as a visible notice
on the document page, and a test asserts the notice is present whenever
an entry exists. The site's credibility is that it IS the record; a
silent gap would undo exactly that.
The page is withheld, never altered. Editing the content of another
party's filed pleading is not something this site does.

waynedo26-104594-do-opposing-01waynedivo.reason: The page carried unredacted personal identifiers of the kind MCR 1.109(D)(9) keeps out of a public filing.
waynedo26-104594-do-opposing-01waynedivo.authority: Withholding is consistent with the Court's standing redaction order in this case.
